## Description

The review found the deployed environment cannot work yet. (1) `infra/bicep/main.bicep` sets `Postgres__Host`, `Postgres__Database` and `ColumnEncryption__KeyVaultKeyUrl`, but the code reads `ConnectionStrings:Medvya`, `NationalIdProtection:KeyVaultKeyId`, `Audit:DigestKey` and `Storage:ConnectionString`. Align the names, add `Audit__DigestKey` as a Key Vault reference, and connect with an Entra access token (Npgsql with the managed identity; no password). (2) `.github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml` still runs SQL firewall rules and an SQL connection; migrations must run from inside the private network (self-hosted runner, a Container Apps job or a deploy-time job in the VNet) as `medvya_migrator` then apply `infra/postgres/roles.sql`. (3) Create the `ledger-digests` container in Bicep with a locked time-based immutability policy, give the app identity append-only access, and make a missing digest Critical once any digest has existed. (4) Use the versionless Key Vault key URI everywhere so rotation needs no redeploy. Prove it with a real dev deployment and a smoke test: sign in, create a patient, see the audit chain verify.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the Bicep app settings, when the app starts in Azure, then it finds a database connection, the national-ID key id and the digest key and registers every module.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the deploy workflow, when a tag is pushed, then migrations and roles run inside the private network and the deploy succeeds with no SQL firewall step.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the ledger-digests container, when anyone with the app identity tries to delete or overwrite a digest, then the storage account refuses it.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a tenant chain that has had a digest, when the digest is missing at verification, then a Critical alert is raised, not a warning.
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the dev environment, when the smoke test runs, then sign-in, patient create and chain verification all pass.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
